description: This file is a shell script designed for performance testing related to the 'last-modified' functionality in a Git environment. It sources an external library 'perf-lib.sh' and contains test cases to verify the behavior of the 'git last-modified' command on various scenarios, including top-level and subdirectory cases.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or sets up the default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified parameters and description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the performance testing script.
